answer: Every zenith is one false identity. Each key anchors at a vertex in the ledger, a slot that opens once, and two keys claiming one vertex burn together. A slot opens only when unrelated backers each post a voyage of judged service as bond, which the newcomer pays for and loses if it is caught as a clone. A backer serves one slot per voyage, and the roster of unrelated backers is fixed and small, so every zenith burns one more voyage and waits one more round of that roster than the one before. It breaks if one owner holds the roster, or the ledger forks.
